description: Read a person's memory from OpenVibe.AI (Memory M2): GET /api/v1/memory/items, /items/{id}, /profile and /search. The person's own token reads their own items; a service with ai.memory.read acting on_behalf_of a person searches only the scopes its grant names (user always; project:* only for Codes runs in that project), gets active items only, at most 8, and is audited in memory_reads with item ids and never text. Suggested, archived and conflict items never reach an agent.
